newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas Advertising rises on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Havas Advertising rises on rumours.

text.p: Shares in Havas Advertising rose strongly on Monday on rumours Havas wants to increase its stake in the 39 percent-owned unit.
At 1250 GMT, Havas Advertising was up 2.72 percent at 605 francs.

The rumours were sparked by a statement by Havas and Generale des Eaux that they were in talks about their stakes in Canal Plus. French newspapers said Havas would acquire Generale des Eaux's stake in Canal Plus in exchange for shares. Havas recently launched a buy-out of minority shareholders in its CEP Communications unit.
At Havas there was no immediate comment on the rumour.
